text:
maria: Sharing flight-recorder dump from today's KV priming runs — saw weird evict/insert churn under shadow replay at ~4k QPS. Dump + notes uploaded to the ticket.

devin: can you paste the experiment command & config?

maria: Config: shadow replay of prod trace against dev-serving (same model, new kernel selection heuristics). Command:
```
./run_replay --trace=2026-03-17-prod.json --qps=4000 --mode=shadow --kv=true --prefetch=on --batch-policy=latency
```

simon: what do you mean by churn? hitrate drop or correctness failures?

maria: Both. Hitrate oscillates 63% -> 47% during warmup windows; also saw occasional duplicate KV writes flagged by the consistency checker (looks like a race between insert and eviction).

perf-bot: kv_hitrate=0.63 avg_latency=12.4ms evictions_per_sec=128 cpu_p95=72%

anya: does synthetic workload reproduce the issue?

maria: No — synth runs (uniform key dist, same QPS) warm much faster and hit ~75% steady. Shadow replay reproduces hotspots & temporal locality; plus the runtime switched kernel path to "mini-kernel-v2" for seq lengths 64-96 which changed memory allocation cadence and increased cache pressure.

ryan: that kernel swap + batching heuristic interaction could explain pacing differences. mini-kernel reduces per-token memory but might increase churn if it batches differently. any pprof/flame data?

maria: attached flame + flight-recorder. Observations: lots of `kv::evict_lock` wait stacks during replay. pprof snapshot shows goroutine 23 burning ~120ms in eviction loop bursts. No syscall spikes.

devin: action items: (1) reproduce with deterministic replay and 2x cache size; (2) pin kernel to v1 to isolate kernel change; I'll take kernel pin test.

simon: add a slow concurrency ramp (0->100%) and log per-key access histograms to correlate eviction spikes with concurrency percentiles.

anya: :thumbsup: creating INF ticket and adding repro artifacts.

maria: Ticket: https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-8921 — notes, flight-recorder, flame and CSVs uploaded. Plan: run pinned-kernel vs dynamic-kernel with 2x cache and the ramp today; will report results by EOD.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: started run INF-8921-repro-1 on dev-cluster-03

devin: if we confirm a race, possible fixes: mutex around eviction/insert, or switch to epoch-based lazy-evict to avoid duplicate writes. Epochs likely easier logically but may lower peak throughput.

maria: quick pinned-kernel numbers: hitrate -> 70% steady, evictions/sec down ~60%. Full CSV to follow.

simon: also add microbench for kv-insert under high batch sizes — could be pathological mem copies under certain batch layouts.

maria: :eyes: thanks everyone. Summary + next steps are in INF-8921. I'll post final repro CSV and flame later.
